findings.statement: D4 describes a sixteen-year-old male patient brought to the emergency room with pain and swelling in his upper back at a site where a biopsy had been performed two months earlier; at age 9 he developed tender stiffness of his shoulders and neck, and over the next four years he had multiple similar upper back swellings, progressively limited shoulder and neck movement, and growing masses.

D4 attributes the case to fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva and reports that the patient had classic features of FOP and was managed by genetic analysis, with DNA sequence analysis of ACVR1/ALK2 able to confirm the diagnosis.
